_note: Terrain horizon (item j). For each site inside the LOLA polar DEM coverage, scripts/horizon.py casts rays from the site over the DEM and keeps the highest elevation angle per azimuth. Elevation is measured from the same local tangent plane (ideal sphere, radius 1737.4 km) as the JPL Horizons tables, so Sun/Earth elevation and terrain horizon can be compared directly. DEM files are downloaded to the cache folder (outside the repo); only the small profiles go into data/horizon/.
